runs.name: Enagas, S.A.; OTC ADS ENGGY at two ADSs per ordinary share, Madrid ENG, no SEC annual report, read from its own annual reports in EUR; the Spanish gas TSO
runs.entry: Price **EUR 16.81** (Madrid close 2026-10-16) and **USD 9.37 an ADS** (OTC close 2026-10-16, 400 ADSs traded), both Yahoo, **aggregator, live quote only, flagged**; ADS ratio two ADSs per ordinary share (F-6EF of 2019-11-22, 0001193805-19-001749); ECB reference rate USD 1.1253 per EUR, 2026-10-16. Shares 260,009,776 outstanding (261,990,074 issued less 1,980,298 treasury, 2025 Annual Report Notes 3.1.a and 3.1.c); `Screens/cover_shares.py` and `tools/run.py` returned not an SEC filer. Sovereign for the earnings currency (EUR) **3.67%**, ECB AAA 30-year spot, 2026-10-15. Read from the 2025 Annual Report (English, with the audited Consolidated Annual Financial Statements, auditor EY), the Informe Anual 2024 and 2023, the Annual Reports 2020, 2018 and 2016, the Informe Anual 2022 from the Universitat Autonoma de Barcelona mirror (flagged, the company's own document, its 2022 figures agreeing with the issuer-hosted 2023 report), and the 2026 results releases of 2026-02-17, 2026-04-21 and 2026-07-22. Cross-check: net financial debt EUR 2,475.1M at 2025-12-31 in the management report agrees with Note 3.4.a. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the annual report's business, risk and management sections, stated in the run file. **Q1 IN**: a formula-remunerated Spanish gas TSO, regulated gas 67% of 2025 operating profit (80% in 2024); the return 5.44% on net, non-indexed asset value for 2021 to 2026, about 6.5% for 2027 to 2032 by the regulator's approved method in the company's figure, the transmission circulars still drafts. **Q2 IN**: a statutory monopoly, the only certified TSO and sole carrier on the primary network; the regulator-set ordinary return carried as a second best; the base shrinking, capital spending below depreciation every year since 2017 (2025 118.1 against 283.8), EBITDA 895.3 (2021) to 675.7 (2025), 2026 target about 620. **Q3 weighs against**: about 8% pre-tax on tangible capital; about EUR 3.4bn put abroad 2015 to 2020, much of it in Tallgrass, part-funded by a EUR 500M share issue at EUR 21.50 in 2019, Tallgrass sold in 2024 for USD 1.1bn with a net loss of EUR 363.7M; the hydrogen plan (EUR 3,125M to 2030) without a remuneration framework. **Q4 weighs against, no STOP**: EBITDA and recurring figures in the headlines, dividends above net profit by about EUR 456M over 2016 to 2025, a weighted share count above shares issued in Note 1.7 recorded. **Q5 integrity IN** (two employees under criminal investigation in Peru over the GSP award, the indictment returned and the civil claim ruled inadmissible in January 2026 subject to appeal, ICSID finding no irregularity; the 2024 loss called a clean-up without the word mistake); ability against. **Q6 weighs against**: EUR 820.9M paid beyond profit over 2021 to 2025; pending 31.5% of Terega for EUR 573M cash and 20% more of Saggas for EUR 31M; a quarter of the long-term plan on hydrogen spending; a 3% legal voting cap. **Q7 OUT**: owner cash (operating cash plus investee dividends less capital spending and purchases) 2021 to 2025 626.2, 697.1, 392.9, 475.0, 179.7 (EUR M), average 474.2 equity-only, 509.9 all-equity, 597.0 before purchases after year ten; growth -4.82% a year carried as the bottom; floor tested first, expected return 8.04% no-growth and 5.54% decline all-equity (equity-only no-growth 11.52%, on 2.1% debt, never deciding alone). Value range EUR 29.72 to 50.28 a share all-equity at the sovereign (USD 16.72 to 28.29 an ADS), equity-only 36.76 to 56.05; **fair price EUR 8.45 a share all-equity (USD 4.75 an ADS)**, equity-only EUR 16.78 (USD 9.44 an ADS). Balance sheets 2015 to 2025: assets 9,874 (2021) to 6,823, PP&E down every year from 5,501 (2017) to 3,679, net debt 4,277 (2021) to 2,475 from asset sales, equity 3,218 (2022) to 2,317, 427.0 owed to the regulator for system surpluses. The annual report names no rival; Snam chosen as a CONVENTION of the run, operating profit 1,430 to 1,845 over 2021 to 2025 against Enagas 583.4 to 368.1, end years only. Three conventions of the run confessed: growth before the gas-system working-capital swings, divestment proceeds not counted as owner cash, the 25% Spanish rate on the interest add-back. Contamination declared by the analyst: CNIG commit subjects, two other tickers' research folder names in git status, memory index lines and the lock file, none used. Commits a08c08d0 (template), e3955f6e (Step 0 and Q1), 6ad75a8e (Q2), 56491b25 (Q3 and Q4 in one commit, declared), 6348b512 (Q5), a20a3df3 (Q6), 59d09fe2 (Q7 and the rest). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the dispatcher's `_dispatcher_cite_check.py` 58 ids, no E-ids, 38 quoted fragments beside an id, 0 slips; **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): working capital that is not the company's money (pass-through settlement balances under (d) and (a)); how a net seller is treated under (c); the range at the sovereign far above a price that every case fails at the floor, inviting misreading; today's or a refinancing cost for the interest add-back when debt is very cheap; Q2 for a statutory monopoly, where the question is the regulator's future conduct; the template's accession number and tool lines for a non-SEC issuer.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7, on price (Enagas, the Spanish gas TSO, read from its own annual reports; Q1 IN, Q2 IN on a statutory monopoly at a regulator-set ordinary return carried as a second best, the base shrinking with capital spending below depreciation since 2017; Q3, Q4 and Q6 against, Tallgrass sold at a EUR 363.7M loss and dividends above profit; Q5 integrity IN with the Peru proceedings recorded; expected return 8.04% no-growth and 5.54% decline all-equity; value range EUR 29.72 to 50.28 all-equity at the sovereign, fair EUR 8.45 a share, USD 4.75 an ADS, equity-only EUR 16.78; armed at the all-equity ADS figure. No citation slip. Framework gaps for the operator: pass-through working capital, a net seller under (c), the range against the floor, the interest add-back on cheap debt, Q2 for a statutory monopoly, a non-SEC issuer in the template.)
